title: White Dog Brewing
venue_description:
Downtown Boise Craft Brewery

White Dog Brewing Company is an award-winning craft brewery located in downtown Boise featuring 16 house-made beers on tap alongside wine cider and non-alcoholic beverage options. The brewery's mission is to provide customers with a truly exceptional one-of-a-kind beer drinking experience delivering dependable variety with unparalleled taste.

Taproom Experience

The taproom features a unique custom frost rail that keeps glasses ice-cold a spacious patio area and large garage doors that open during nice weather creating an indoor-outdoor atmosphere. The venue maintains a relaxed welcoming environment suitable for all ages with families welcome on the patio. Food is provided by rotating food trucks including favorites like Smoke and Thyme offering high-end pub fare.

Music & Community Events

White Dog Brewing is deeply connected to Boise's music scene hosting the weekly Monday night Old-Time Jam session between Labor Day and Memorial Day. The venue also features regular live music performances throughout the week. With its combination of award-winning beer community atmosphere and commitment to acoustic music White Dog has become a cornerstone venue for Boise's traditional music community.

Location & Atmosphere

Situated at 705 W Fulton St in downtown Boise the brewery occupies a distinctive space with ample natural light from skylights and a generous amount of space between tables creating a comfortable dining and socializing environment. The brewery also operates a second location in Caldwell Idaho.

title: Westy's Garden Lanes
venue_description:
Family Bowling & Entertainment Center

Westy's Garden Lanes has been a beloved fixture in the Boise area for over 25 years providing family-friendly bowling and entertainment. Located in Garden City just outside downtown Boise this classic bowling alley offers a welcoming old-school atmosphere with modern amenities and a commitment to community events.

Bowling & Facilities

The venue features numerous bowling lanes equipped with modern computer scoring systems and entertaining graphics that make the experience fun for all ages. The facility includes a full-service sports bar cafe and pro shop. Guests appreciate the clean well-maintained lanes and the relaxed easy-going vibe that makes Westy's feel like a neighborhood gathering place rather than a corporate entertainment complex.

Music & Entertainment

Westy's Garden Lanes hosts a weekly Tuesday night Open Mic series led by local musician Landonious Monk. These acoustic sessions welcome musicians poets and performers of all kinds creating a platform for local artists to share their talents. The venue provides a casual comfortable setting perfect for both performers and audiences. The open mic nights run from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM and resumed in January 2025 after a seasonal break.

Community Hub

Beyond bowling and music Westy's serves as a true community gathering space. The venue is family-oriented with reasonable prices and a friendly staff that creates a welcoming environment. Ample parking is available and the location is easily accessible from throughout the Treasure Valley. Operating hours are Monday through Thursday 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM Friday and Saturday 9:00 AM to 1:00 AM and Sunday 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

title: Boise Hive
venue_description:
Nonprofit Music Community & Mental Health Center

Boise Hive is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to preventing suicide in the music community through mental health services education and creative programming. Located in the historic Custom Recording & Sound building on the Boise Bench the Hive provides a safe sober all-ages space where musicians and artists can practice perform learn and access vital mental health resources.

Mission & Mental Health Services

The core mission of Boise Hive is to safeguard mental health within the music community with a focus on suicide prevention. The organization offers complimentary counseling educational opportunities and comprehensive mental health resources tailored to support musicians at every stage of their journey. Individual counseling services and support groups are integral to the mission providing compassionate care to those navigating mental health challenges. The organization envisions a future where the creative community thrives in emotional well-being and mental health challenges are addressed openly and effectively.

Facilities & Rehearsal Spaces

The Hive features four professional studios/rehearsal spaces a community room multimedia room recording studio and a snack bar. Musicians can book practice spaces through the venue's convenient online booking platform (Skedda). The facility maintains a drug and alcohol-free environment making it an ideal haven for young musicians including teenagers and young adults to explore and grow their talents safely.

Music Programs & Events

Boise Hive hosts an extensive array of music programs and events. The monthly Open Mic Night (last Wednesday of each month 6:30-8:00 PM) welcomes musicians poets and performers of all kinds. Live at the Hive concerts happen every Saturday showcasing diverse musical genres and providing worldwide streaming of performances. The venue also hosts the Gene Harris Jazz Jam sessions in partnership with Boise State University offering jazz musicians opportunities to practice improvisation and collaboration.

Educational programs include Audio Recording Classes Student Jazz sessions Veterans Sessions Creative Culture Beats Hip Hop at The Hive and HiveTronica for electronic and experimental musicians. All programs emphasize the connection between artistic expression and mental well-being.

Community Impact

Boise Hive operates primarily through volunteers (98% of the workforce) creating opportunities for community members to gain new skills while making a positive impact. The venue serves a wide range of community members from veterans seeking camaraderie to young artists exploring their talents. Through music education wellness programs and collaborative events the Hive fosters a nurturing creative community that empowers musicians and artists throughout Idaho. Operating hours are Monday-Friday 12:00 PM-10:00 PM and Saturday-Sunday 2:00 PM-10:00 PM though hours may vary as a volunteer-operated facility.

title: Morrison Center
venue_description:
Idaho's Premier Performing Arts Venue

The Velma V. Morrison Center for the Performing Arts stands as Idaho's home for the arts nestled on the banks of the Boise River on the Boise State University campus. The venue's distinctive 10-story stage house is a recognizable fixture of Boise's skyline offering panoramic views of the city parks and foothills.

Facilities & Capacity

Morrison Center features three performance spaces: the Main Hall (2037 seats) with world-class acoustics and technical capabilities the Danny Peterson Theatre (210 seats) for intimate productions and the Recital Hall (200 seats) for chamber music and smaller performances. The Main Hall features excellent sightlines with no bad seats in the house and staggered seating that ensures clear views regardless of the height of guests in front. The venue offers accessible seating assistive listening devices sign language interpretation and comprehensive accessibility accommodations.

Programming & Events

The Morrison Center presents a diverse season of programming including Broadway touring productions presented by MagicSpace Entertainment symphony performances dance companies jazz concerts and community events. Recent and upcoming productions include Disney's The Lion King Hamilton and other major Broadway tours. The venue also hosts the Gene Harris Jazz Jam sessions continuing the legacy of the legendary pianist who profoundly impacted Boise's music community.

Visitor Experience

Event parking is included in ticket prices with parking available in the Brady Garage at University and Earle Street and nearby surface lots. Limited accessible parking is available near the Morrison Center academic entrance. The venue features concessions offering wine beer and snacks at reasonable prices with efficient service that allows guests to return to their seats quickly during intermissions. Box office hours are Monday-Friday 10:00 AM-3:00 PM with extended hours on event days.

Community Impact

Morrison Center serves as a cultural cornerstone for Boise and the state of Idaho. Recent economic impact studies show the center generates $27.9 million in value to the local and state economy. The venue partners with local businesses to provide discounts on dining lodging and transportation for patrons creating a comprehensive arts experience that extends beyond the theater itself.

title: Liquid Lounge
venue_description:
Downtown Boise Late-Night Entertainment Venue

Liquid Lounge is an award-winning bar restaurant and entertainment venue located in downtown Boise's famous BoDo (Boise Downtown) district. Known for its vibrant late-night atmosphere the venue combines food drinks arcade games and live entertainment including comedy shows and open mic nights.

Entertainment & Events

Liquid Lounge features regular comedy shows Thursday through Sunday attracting some of the country's best comedians. The venue hosts Liquid Laughs comedy open mic on Wednesday nights providing a platform for comedians of all levels from first-timers to traveling professionals to test material and hone their craft. Comedy workshops are also available during the week for those looking to learn the craft. The venue features an adult-only arcade with pool tables air hockey bowling and other games creating a fun atmosphere for socializing.

Food & Drink

The venue serves an extensive food menu until midnight Sunday-Thursday and 1:00 AM Friday-Saturday including gluten-free and vegan options. The bar offers a good selection of beer wine and cocktails with standout margaritas frequently mentioned by guests. Drink specials are available and the venue is known for its lively atmosphere.

Venue Details

Liquid Lounge features a clean colorful interior with comfortable seating arrangements and a covered patio. The venue operates Monday-Sunday from 2:30 PM to 2:00 AM. Seating is first-come first-served so arriving early for popular events is recommended. The venue also offers banquet facilities through its adjoining sister company Solid Grill & Bar for parties and birthdays.
